definitions.full: H7285. regesh [ רֶ֫גֶשׁ ] noun [masculine] throng ; — בִּרָ֑נֶשׁ נְהֵלֵךְ Psa 55:15 used to walk in the throng (compare הָמוֺן 42:5 , also to אלהים בית ). [ רִגְשָׁה ] noun feminine throng ; — construct אָ֫וֶן מֹּעֲלֵי רִגְשַׁת Psa 64:3 ; so (of worshippers, compare רֶגֶשׁ ) 68:28 , reading רִגְשָׁתָם for רֹגְמָתָם , Hup Pe Bi Che Bae Dr.
